brief: Prioritise pre-event attention for Briarcliff Bend 230/34kV ahead of a younger unit in otherwise similar condition because it is an ageing unit of advanced age with a history of high loading, giving it a reduced margin against mechanical failure (MG-023). If the unit cannot be attended before the heat event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure (MG-023). Where the unit is identified for pre-event attention and an obstruction defect is outstanding, clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity to maintain airflow (SOP-011).
